title: Optimal Temporal Hiding in Correlated Quantum Reference-Frame Processes
summary: A finite group-valued temporal reference frame defines a correlated random-unitary process rather than a list of independent channels. We identify a regime in which its complete trajectory law is an exact operational coordinate. If the carrier contains every irreducible representation of the finite group $G$, one ancilla-assisted input resolves all group elements, and for arbitrary laws $μ,ν$ on $G^n$ the strategy half-distance equals $d_{\mathrm{TV}}(μ,ν)$.
